Dear Paperkite Hiring Team,

I am writing to follow up on my recent application for the Frontend Developer position. I remain very enthusiastic about the opportunity to join your team. 

As a frontend developer, I bring hands-on experience building marketing websites with Next.js that consistently achieve Lighthouse scores of 95 and above, as well as working directly with Figma designs to create reusable React components. 

Thank you for your time and consideration of my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your needs.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
